author: packs
description: Work orders (I1-T1): types, incident types, the work order linked to the asset, the ticket and the entitlement, its tasks, part and service lines, and time and travel entries, with statuses, a customer signature and the invoice hand-off. Maintenance (I5-T1): plans triggered every N days, at a meter threshold or on a date, with task templates. Warranties (I10-T1): warranty terms per product, the warranty source on entitlements and warranty claims with supplier recovery.
name: field-service-work-orders
title: Pack: field service work orders, maintenance and warranties
